title: demo-scenario
description: Envelope of a demo scenario under schema/demo/<entity>[.<id>].demo.json. `initial` is one complete entity record (it must validate against <entity>.schema.json); each `timeline` step overlays `set` on the running state and the merged result must validate too (checked by schema/validate-demo.py, which JSON Schema alone cannot express). The scenario loops every `loop_s` seconds, resetting to `initial`, like Venus OS's dbus-recorder replay.

id.description: The topic id segment (renewvan/demo/<entity>/<id>/...). Never contains MQTT wildcards or `/`, and never one of the ids consumers treat specially: `driver` (liveness topics are dropped by id), or `demo`, `enabled`, `health` (the namespace's own control topics).

t.description: Seconds from loop start; must be < loop_s and non-decreasing.
